OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro.en: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nIt's exquisite.
OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro.fr: Allongé, bercé par les vagues…\nC'est exquis.

OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBa.en: The sea is pleasantly warm in these\nparts.
OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBa.fr: La mer est agréablement chaude dans\nle coin.

OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsW.en: Good things get washed up by the\nocean current onto this beach.\pThat's why I often come here for\nsome beachcombing.
OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsW.fr: De bonnes choses sont rejetées par\nle courant sur cette plage.\pC'est pourquoi je viens souvent\nici pour ramasser des trésors.
